missingInformation: The document gives no floor plan or exact placement of offices, warehouses, council spaces, or the Camp Sheridan guardhouse.
The document does not preserve the exact spoken words of Spotted Tail, Two Strike, or other Lakota leaders in council.
The report names Two Strike but does not record his personal reasoning, so his dialogue and motives are inferred.
The report does not identify any interpreter by name, so the player character is a simulation role from the teacher brief.
The source does not describe what the Commissioner of Indian Affairs replied after receiving Lee’s report.
The source does not say whether Crazy Horse finally came to this agency after the report date.
The source does not record McGirk’s own defense in his own words.
